advisory_seeds.title: March 2013 chain fork
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Environment/database limit changed consensus acceptance across versions.

advisory_seeds.title: Duplicate-input crash and inflation
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Optimization removed full validation; assertion and UTXO mutation semantics allowed crash/inflation.

advisory_seeds.title: Script interpreter use-after-free
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Early return destroyed borrowed precomputation before asynchronous checks completed.

advisory_seeds.title: blocktxn assertion crash
advisory_seeds.root_shape: A one-shot reconstruction object remained reusable after partial failure.

advisory_seeds.title: Mutated block hinders propagation
advisory_seeds.root_shape: One peer cleared block-download state owned by other peers.

advisory_seeds.title: Stalling peer hinders block propagation
advisory_seeds.root_shape: First announcer retained exclusive progress ownership while withholding data.

advisory_seeds.title: Orphan handling significant DoS
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Nested orphan scan and expensive invalid validation caused hours of stall.

advisory_seeds.title: Transaction re-request censorship
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Bounded-map eviction reset request authority to an attacker.

advisory_seeds.title: Adjusted-time netsplit
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Signed overflow and INT64_MIN absolute-value behavior bypassed a time bound.

advisory_seeds.title: Low-work headers memory exhaustion
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Attacker-controlled low-work header state was retained without an adequate aggregate/phase bound.

advisory_seeds.title: Addr insertion ID overflow
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Long-horizon 32-bit identifier overflow; an earlier rate limit reduced feasibility without removing terminal wrap.

advisory_seeds.title: Unbounded ban list and quadratic scan
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Attacker-influenced global list plus nested per-response scans.

advisory_seeds.title: Incomplete-message receive-buffer OOM
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Per-connection maximum receive allocation escaped a process-wide bound.

advisory_seeds.title: Huge INV memory DoS
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Legal message cardinality caused large per-peer container allocation.

advisory_seeds.title: Huge GETDATA CPU loop
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Malformed queue/input handling failed to guarantee progress or consumption.

advisory_seeds.title: SOCKS signed-char buffer overflow
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Signed byte length crossed into a wider unsigned syscall size.

advisory_seeds.title: miniupnpc dependency RCE
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Optional dependency exposed local-network memory corruption and RCE.

advisory_seeds.title: 32-bit pathological-block crash
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Word-size overflow in a disk-size check became conceivable through compact-block ingress.

advisory_seeds.title: Invalid unconfirmed transaction CPU DoS
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Invalid script contexts performed seconds of repeated hashing before rejection.

advisory_seeds.title: Log/disk filling
advisory_seeds.root_shape: Attacker-controlled repeated events produced unbounded logs until global rate limiting was added.

knowledgebase_families.theme: Compact block ownership, replay, and repeated work
Headers, transaction request, orphan, and peer-local liveness
Fee, cluster, iterator, time, and file-width arithmetic
PSBT, MuSig2, and external signer authorization
Backports, trusted-key quorum, Git ancestry, and artifact verification

negative_controls.claim: Null compact extra transaction slots are live on current master.
negative_controls.reason: Merged #35670 changed resize-based empty slots to reserve/emplace populated entries.

negative_controls.claim: Inner PSBT deserialization accepts trailing bytes through production RPC/GUI/wallet paths.
negative_controls.reason: Production outer decoders reject extra data; direct inner construction is not the framing boundary.

negative_controls.claim: Scientific-notation RPC amounts are an accidental parser weakness.
negative_controls.reason: ParseFixedPoint intentionally accepts tested exponent forms with range/precision checks.

negative_controls.claim: Prior rotr UB and UniValue assertion reports remain live.
negative_controls.reason: Knowledgebase records explicit retraction after audit; require a new reproducer.

negative_controls.claim: Repeated local oracle commits are independent vulnerabilities.
negative_controls.reason: Duplicated-subject/date batches and fuzzer-oracle changes are evidence infrastructure, not roots.

negative_controls.claim: A direct component API hazard is automatically remote/consensus exploitable.
negative_controls.reason: Trace actual public/in-tree callers; label latent contract hardening accurately.

selection_rule: Prioritize consensus, realistic remote crashes/memory safety, funds/signing authorization, durable recovery, and censorship/liveness. Resource-only variants may occupy at most one of five Core cycles unless they demonstrate a distinct root, practical default-node kill, or deeper integrity failure.
